focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：关键矿产出口管制博弈升级与美欧对华关税工具调整并行
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸主线围绕关键矿产与新能源供应链展开。中国对镓、锗等半导体关键材料的出口管制执行进一步细化，企业许可申请周期延长；美国与欧盟则分别推进对华电动汽车及电池组件的关税与反补贴措施评估，并强化外国投资审查。与此同时，多边层面围绕WTO争端解决机制改革的磋商继续，但短期内难以形成约束性成果。整体趋势显示，主要经济体正将贸易政策与产业安全深度捆绑，合规成本与供应链重构压力同步上升。出海企业需关注许可审批、原产地规则及第三国转口合规风险。
focus.source: 来源：综合WTO、美国商务部、欧盟委员会及中国商务部公开信息 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Focus: Critical Minerals Export Control Standoff and Parallel Tariff Tool Adjustments by the US and EU
focus.summary_en: This week's international trade agenda centered on critical minerals and new-energy supply chains. China further refined the implementation of export controls on gallium, germanium and other semiconductor-critical materials, extending licensing timelines for companies. The United States and the European Union each advanced assessments of tariffs and countervailing measures on Chinese electric vehicles and battery components, while tightening foreign investment screening. Meanwhile, multilateral discussions on WTO dispute settlement reform continued but are unlikely to yield binding outcomes in the near term. The overarching trend shows major economies deeply intertwining trade policy with industrial security, driving up compliance costs and supply-chain restructuring pressures. Outbound companies should monitor licensing approvals, rules of origin and third-country transshipment compliance risks.
focus.source_en: Source: Compiled from public information of the WTO, US Department of Commerce, European Commission and China's Ministry of Commerce · this week

case.title: 本周案例：香港仲裁庭认可内地保全措施效力，跨境争议临时救济协作再获突破
case.summary: 本周香港国际仲裁中心（HKIAC）公布的一宗涉内地企业跨境供货合同争议中，仲裁庭依据《关于内地与香港特别行政区法院就仲裁程序相互协助保全的安排》，批准了申请人向内地法院申请财产保全的请求，并认可内地法院已采取的查封措施在仲裁程序中的证据效力。该案凸显内地与香港在仲裁临时救济领域的协作机制日趋成熟，为出海企业提供了更可预期的资产保全路径。启示在于：跨境合同中应明确约定仲裁地与保全适用规则，并在争议初期同步启动两地保全申请，避免资产转移导致裁决落空。
case.source: 来源：香港国际仲裁中心（HKIAC）案例通报 · 本周
case.title_en: Weekly Case: Hong Kong Arbitral Tribunal Recognizes Mainland Preservation Measures, Breakthrough in Cross-Border Interim Relief Cooperation
case.summary_en: This week, the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre (HKIAC) published a cross-border supply contract dispute involving a mainland enterprise in which the arbitral tribunal, pursuant to the Arrangement Concerning Mutual Assistance in Court-ordered Interim Measures in Aid of Arbitral Proceedings between the Mainland and the Hong Kong SAR, granted the applicant's request to seek property preservation from mainland courts and recognized the evidentiary effect of the seizure measures already taken by mainland courts in the arbitration. The case highlights the maturing cooperation mechanism between the Mainland and Hong Kong in interim relief, offering outbound companies a more predictable asset preservation path. The takeaway: cross-border contracts should clearly stipulate the seat of arbitration and applicable preservation rules, and preservation applications in both jurisdictions should be initiated simultaneously at the early stage of a dispute to prevent asset dissipation from rendering an award unenforceable.
case.source_en: Source: HKIAC case bulletin · this week

policy.title: 本周政策：粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动与涉外法治服务便利化措施密集落地
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外及粤港澳大湾区政策聚焦数据跨境与法律服务便利化。国家网信办与相关部门进一步优化粤港澳大湾区个人信息跨境流动标准合同备案流程，扩大适用行业范围；广东省及深圳、珠海等地发布涉外法治人才培养与涉外法律服务集聚区支持措施，鼓励港澳律师事务所在大湾区内地九市设立联营所。同时，海关总署推动跨境电商出口退货监管便利化，降低企业合规成本。这些政策共同指向以制度型开放降低跨境交易壁垒，出海企业应关注数据合规路径选择及港澳法律资源对接，提前布局跨境合规架构。
policy.source: 来源：国家网信办、海关总署及广东省司法厅公开信息 · 本周
policy.title_en: Weekly Policy: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow and Foreign-Related Legal Services Facilitation Measures Intensify
policy.summary_en: This week, China's foreign-related and Greater Bay Area (GBA) policies focused on cross-border data and legal services facilitation. The Cyberspace Administration of China and relevant departments further streamlined the filing process for standard contracts on cross-border personal information flows in the GBA, expanding the scope of applicable industries; Guangdong Province and cities including Shenzhen and Zhuhai issued support measures for cultivating foreign-related legal talent and clustering foreign-related legal services, encouraging Hong Kong and Macao law firms to establish joint ventures in the nine mainland GBA cities. Meanwhile, the General Administration of Customs promoted facilitation of cross-border e-commerce export return supervision, reducing compliance costs. These policies collectively aim to lower cross-border transaction barriers through institutional opening-up. Outbound companies should monitor data compliance pathway options and connect with Hong Kong and Macao legal resources, planning their cross-border compliance architecture in advance.
policy.source_en: Source: Public information of the Cyberspace Administration of China, General Administration of Customs and Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：供应链合规从被动应对转向主动架构，下周关注关税清单与数据出境细则
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周信号表明，主要经济体的贸易与投资限制正从单点制裁转向系统性供应链审查，企业仅靠事后应对已不足够。建议出海企业：一是对关键物料建立双源采购与替代市场预案，并同步评估第三国转口的原产地与再出口合规；二是在跨境合同中嵌入制裁与出口管制触发条款、价格调整机制及争议解决的多层设计；三是提前完成数据出境路径选择与备案，避免业务扩张受阻。下周重点关注：美国对华关税清单调整的公众评议节点、欧盟电池法规实施细则动向，以及粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动新指引的落地口径。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队 · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Supply Chain Compliance Shifts from Reactive Response to Proactive Structuring; Watch Tariff Lists and Data Export Rules Next Week
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's signals indicate that trade and investment restrictions in major economies are shifting from point sanctions to systemic supply chain reviews, making after-the-fact responses insufficient. Recommendations for outbound companies: first, establish dual-source procurement and alternative market contingency plans for critical materials, while assessing rules of origin and re-export compliance for third-country transshipment; second, embed sanctions and export control trigger clauses, price adjustment mechanisms and multi-tier dispute resolution designs in cross-border contracts; third, complete data export pathway selection and filing in advance to avoid hindering business expansion. Key focuses next week: the public comment milestone for US tariff list adjustments on China, developments in the EU Battery Regulation implementing rules, and the implementation guidance for new GBA cross-border data flow guidelines.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao's team · this week
